name: Shree Ganesh Bio-Tech (India) Limited
about: Shree Ganesh Bio-Tech (India) Limited engages in plant tissue culture activities in India. The company engaged in trading seeds and bhushi. It also engages in production, processing, and marketing of hybrid seeds for various crops, including corn, sunflower, cotton, paddy, grain, and sorghum. The company was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Kolkata, India.
